evals.prompt: Review this supplied patch for bugs. Report findings only; do not change files.
evals.baseline_prompt: Inspect this patch for correctness issues and report only evidence-backed findings. Do not implement changes.
evals.expected_output: Prioritizes actionable correctness issues, cites exact evidence, or says no finding when none is supported.

assertions.criterion: Findings describe impact and point to concrete code evidence; no speculative issues.
Does not implement a fix or claim tests were run without evidence.

evals.overlap_review: Common protocol makes review-only behavior shared; only finding quality and evidence are gradeable.
